integrity: The scientific claims are computationally checked by two distinct exhaustive algorithms and a complete finite certificate; no independent external scientific validation or absolute publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact classification for GP(8,3) only, with explicit choices of token jumps, token slides, adjacent-pair substitutions, and partner-preserving substitutions. No infinite-family generalization. Reconfiguration states are eight-vertex sets, not labeled pairings.
title: Paired-domination mobility and matched-pair rigidity in the Möbius–Kantor graph
